$comment: Vectors pinning the full, ordered warning list NormalizeSAFSupplement emits when it rewrites a legacy top-level `passthrough`: first either the deprecation notice (it was normalized into extensions.passthrough) or, in its place, the notice that it was dropped because extensions.passthrough already holds a different value (a deep-equal one counts as normalized); then one warning per undeclared `extensions` sibling. Shared by Go and TypeScript so the two cannot drift. Each case writes its siblings in an insertion order that differs from the sorted one: Go reads them into a map and so cannot see source order, which is why the rule is code-point order of the key in both languages. Each case's `extensions` is spliced into a minimal valid results document beside a legacy top-level `passthrough`, which is what triggers the relocation.

vectors.why: three siblings, one clashing with a key already in passthrough, are reported in key order
warnings: deprecated: top-level 'passthrough' was normalized into extensions.passthrough; write provenance under extensions — this compatibility shim will be removed in a future release
extensions.alpha was moved into extensions.passthrough.alpha; `extensions` accepts only its defined members
extensions.mid was dropped: `extensions` is closed and extensions.passthrough.mid already holds a value
extensions.zeta was moved into extensions.passthrough.zeta; `extensions` accepts only its defined members

vectors.why: a non-object passthrough leaves every sibling in place, and reports them in key order
warnings: top-level 'passthrough' was dropped: extensions.passthrough already holds a value
extensions.alpha could not be relocated because extensions.passthrough is not an object; `extensions` is closed, so this document will not validate
extensions.mid could not be relocated because extensions.passthrough is not an object; `extensions` is closed, so this document will not validate
extensions.zeta could not be relocated because extensions.passthrough is not an object; `extensions` is closed, so this document will not validate

vectors.why: a legacy top-level passthrough beside an existing extensions.passthrough object is dropped, and the drop is reported in place of the deprecation notice
warnings: top-level 'passthrough' was dropped: extensions.passthrough already holds a value
extensions.zeta was moved into extensions.passthrough.zeta; `extensions` accepts only its defined members

vectors.why: a legacy top-level passthrough deep-equal to the existing extensions.passthrough loses nothing, so it is reported as normalized, not dropped
warnings: deprecated: top-level 'passthrough' was normalized into extensions.passthrough; write provenance under extensions — this compatibility shim will be removed in a future release
extensions.zeta was moved into extensions.passthrough.zeta; `extensions` accepts only its defined members

vectors.why: a key holding null is a value, so passthroughs differing only by it are not equal and the legacy one is dropped
warnings: top-level 'passthrough' was dropped: extensions.passthrough already holds a value

vectors.why: key order is by code point, not UTF-16 unit: U+E000 sorts before U+10000 although its UTF-16 unit is higher, and a prefix sorts first
warnings: deprecated: top-level 'passthrough' was normalized into extensions.passthrough; write provenance under extensions — this compatibility shim will be removed in a future release
extensions.a was moved into extensions.passthrough.a; `extensions` accepts only its defined members
extensions.ab was moved into extensions.passthrough.ab; `extensions` accepts only its defined members
extensions. was moved into extensions.passthrough.; `extensions` accepts only its defined members
extensions.𐀀 was moved into extensions.passthrough.𐀀; `extensions` accepts only its defined members
